vs_analog_warfare.ponder.vehicle_setup_r: This is the Setup Block. It only records and runs when placed on a ship.
Right-click the Setup Block with the Analog Screwdriver to start recording.
Any block you place from now on is recorded, such as this Shaft.
Tallyho weapons and turrets are also recorded automatically.
Right-click the Setup Block again to stop recording.
Sneak and right-click the Setup Block with an empty hand to open the editor, where you can tweak the recording.
On a ship, right-click the Setup Block with an empty hand to run its recording.
The recorded block is placed automatically.
Re-running the setup again places any remaining recorded blocks.
Blocks that were recorded can also be marked for removal. Sneak and scroll to switch the Screwdriver to removal mode.
Right-click the Setup Block to begin marking.
Right-click a recorded block to mark it for removal, such as this Black Wool.
Right-click the Setup Block again to stop marking. Marked blocks are removed the next time the setup runs.
